discrepancy_summary: Unit price for SKU-002 (Industrial Gloves) differs between the invoice and PO.

subject: Invoice INV-1001 for PO-1001
human_report: Invoice number INV-1001 from Global Logistics Ltd, dated 14 March 2025, totals $1617.00. The invoice includes 50 units of Pallet Wrapping Film at $12.00 each, 120 units of Industrial Gloves at $3.50 each, and 30 Safety Helmets at $15.00 each. A discrepancy has been identified where the unit price for Industrial Gloves differs between the invoice and the PO. Manual review is recommended.
